task_context.problem_statement: I bought a TV for $1700 excluding tax. What is the price of the television when calculating 15% of the value-added tax?
task_context.reference_solution:
The value-added tax is 1700*15% = <<1700*15*.01=255>>255.
The price of the television including tax 1700+255 = $<<1700+255=1955>>1955.
#### 1955
